# Saved manifest input

`cross_region_manifest.json` is read by `tests/aim_save_compat_data.gd` to verify supported historical Plains snapshot replay and reject foreign boss/configuration tuples. It does not define the new fixed world or its save policy. The consumer pins its SHA256.

Original bytes: main `83a149558e670fc78a177d8f4662a0ec079b4cbf`, former `docs/evidence/forest_depth_v2/reviews/campaign-output-helper/cross_region_manifest.json`. Reports and captures are not required.
